bug_semantics: The authenticated GET /download-export endpoint concatenated the attacker-controlled filename query parameter directly onto export_path(), checked only file_exists(), and passed the resulting path to response()->download(). Traversal components could therefore escape the export directory and disclose any file readable by the application process; the demonstrated impact is arbitrary file read, not write or code execution.
flaw_origin: Commit 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8 created app/Http/Controllers/FileDownloadController.php and first wrote `$path = export_path() . $_GET['filename']` followed by file_exists() and response()->download(), while also adding export_path(). Commit 5eda5fcf38a87a1ceb39762474df6c2211def9fb later made the flawed method reachable at /download-export inside the auth middleware group, but did not write the vulnerable path construction. The later import/export aggregate 9049917b3807924bb301f35635d17958b23888cd only added a separate template-download method and retained the vulnerable method unchanged, so neither later commit is the smallest BIC.
ai_marker: absent — BIC commit object has no AI author/co-author/Generated-with marker; see evidence
evidence: The assigned global advisory https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6928-5hpx-7r3v identifies CVE-2026-77914 as authenticated export-download traversal allowing arbitrary file read before 8.2.13, and the first-party advisory https://github.com/rconfig/rconfig/security/advisories/GHSA-m5rw-jcrm-mmwc describes the same mechanism and names 8.2.13 as patched. `git show --format= --find-renames 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8 -- app/Http/Controllers/FileDownloadController.php app/Http/Helpers.php` shows a newly created controller containing the raw filename concatenation, file_exists(), and download sink, plus the new export_path() helper. `git log --all -S"export_path() . \$_GET['filename']" -- app/Http/Controllers/FileDownloadController.php` returns only introduction 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8 and removal d133a466a2df9d065177de9a8ed50f1bfe438aee. `git show --stat --summary --find-renames 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8` reports a focused three-file, 35-insertion/5-deletion commit and creates the controller rather than moving or importing it. `git ls-tree -r 09fa5a4eac1abb8ee5010bb85b39411f36a6fa5e -- app/Http/Controllers/FileDownloadController.php` and parent-tree `git grep` for download_export/export_path/$_GET produce no output, directly proving the immediate parent lacks the file and equivalent flow. `git show 5eda5fcf38a87a1ceb39762474df6c2211def9fb -- routes/web.php` shows later route activation under auth. `git show 9049917b3807924bb301f35635d17958b23888cd -- app/Http/Controllers/FileDownloadController.php` shows the pre-existing vulnerable method unchanged while adding only template download functionality, rejecting that aggregate/import commit as origin. `git cat-file -p 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8` shows exactly one parent, human author and committer `danielrConfig <daniel@rconfig.com>`, and only the message `feat: add file download functionality and export path helper`, with no AI trailer, bot identity, or other AI signal; it is not a merge or squash aggregate. `git show d133a466a2df9d065177de9a8ed50f1bfe438aee -- app/Http/Controllers/FileDownloadController.php` shows the direct fix replacing raw $_GET use with Request input reduced by basename() and requiring realpath-resolved file containment under export_path(), including symlink escape rejection. `git rev-parse core-8.2.12^{} core-8.2.13^{}` resolves the adjacent releases to 28b88100001c277f30a46ef8f512af2e0f59928b and 72b60a41d9589f3b2e0c5ea0062734b6a0b5a86d; the core-8.2.12 controller tree has the raw vulnerable expression, the core-8.2.13 tree has basename plus PathContainmentService containment, and `git tag --contains d133a466a2df9d065177de9a8ed50f1bfe438aee` begins at core-8.2.13. This repository history resolves the first-party page's inconsistent displayed affected expression `<8.2.12` in favor of the global advisory and remediation boundary: 8.2.12 is vulnerable and 8.2.13 is fixed.
reasoning: The vulnerability is the unsafe filesystem path data flow first written by 0813dca72e26bca7f091bb7ffa2da3f3c18d7ac8, not the later route declaration, import/export aggregate, or containment refactor. The new-file diff, independent pickaxe, direct-parent absence, one-parent commit object, direct fix, and adjacent release trees satisfy the BIC, parent, non-move/non-aggregate, fix, and version gates. The assigned marker_state disagreement is resolved in favor of the reviewer's null representation: the primary correctly observed that the BIC commit object contains no AI evidence, but incorrectly placed an explanatory `absent: ...` sentence in ai_marker. Because there is no marker in the BIC object, the canonical ai_marker value is null; the absence explanation belongs in evidence and reasoning. The Claude co-author trailer on the later fix is fix-only evidence and is excluded. With a verified BIC and direct fix and no remaining boundary gap, the gate-complete verdict is NOT_AI.
